reviews.comment: He can be tough if you don't put in the effort, but he's also real interesting if you do. Show up, take notes, and make sure to have as much of the information down as possible because it's all highly likely to be on the exam. Exams are open notes and you can do them at home, but without good notes, they WILL knock you around.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Super engaging professor. If you show up to class and take notes you will do fine. We didn't need to come into class for exams which saved a lot of time. Read assigned books.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: You literally have to write down everything he says. Test questions were difficult and some of the content on the questions wasn't covered.

Wonderfully amazing professor!  Can't say enough good things about him. He's entertaining, kind, and loves what he's doing. History is not my thing, but I learned so much this semester. Exams based on lectures so come to class & pay attention & you'll do well. Three books, two quizzes. So helpful outside of class too. One of the best!!

I took Prof. Mitchell for both 105 & 106. One of the best, if not the best, professor I've had so far. His lectures are so well done, with just the right amount of humor. He's passionate about history & it shows. I've learned so much in his classes and am sad I cannot take him again. Take good notes, read the books, and you will do fine. Take him!

Do you read books in this class, yes, is it very test heavy, yes, but it is still a very very very good course. There is no homeworks other then the books you read, and you can use your notes on all the tests. So as long as you show up to class there is no reason not to get at LEAST a B. Just go to lecture, he is a great professor and chill dude.

Great professor! Super engaging and definitely knows what he's talking about. 4 exams, 2 essays, and 2 quizzes. Literally write down everything he says during lecture as they aren't posted on Canvas and exams are open note but timed.

Insanely good professor! Not a big fan of history, but he makes it fun and relatable. I'm actually telling my roommate about his lectures every week! Everyone should take him. Really nice helpful guy too. Class has two book quizzes, one book paper, one movie paper, and 4 exams from the lectures. Wish every professor was like him.

Very funny and obviously very passionate about the material. He did lecture very fast, but tests were open note with extra credit questions. You have to read 3 books for this class, and write 2 essays, but he provides you with good feedback, and grades the first essay less harshely.

TAKE HIM. He does an incredible job at making his lectures entertaining, this was the first history class I actually learned from. You will write two papers and read three books, it is pretty annoying but you chose one book and a movie. The tests are online and open note. I would take him in a heart beat, one of the best history professors here.

Phenomenal lecturer. Attendance is mandatory (because he doesn't post slides/videos) but I genuinely enjoyed going to class. It is clear that he has a passion for history and it reflects in his engaging material. Take note of fun facts about him; they usually will end up as extra credit on his exams. Would 100% take again.

Prof. Mitchell's lectures are def not skippable since it's all exam content. However, I genuinely enjoyed attending his lectures. It was like listening to a story at times; he made the events seem entertaining. That being said- take VERY good notes. 5 exams (remote & open-note), 2 papers (historical movie & book, he gives lists), & 2 book quizzes.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Best professor I've had in all of college. It's important to attend his lectures because they are directly what is on the exam, but attendance is not taken. Exams are open note and taken online outside of class. He really cares and it is evident. Highly recommend this class!

Professor Mitchell is one of the best professors I have had at A&M. He has a deep passion for history and his class was the most informative class I've had. I learned SO much and truly enjoyed the content. Take really good notes during class and you will do well on exams and quizzes. The two papers are not bad either. Would recommend him to anyone!

I truly enjoyed taking Prof. Mitchell for HIST 105. Book quizzes and tests are open note (only lecture notes/book notes, no internet). If you go to lecture and pay attention, you should do well! He is also extremely funny/entertaining in lectures and gives really good advice/feedback on papers/quizzes/tests. You can tell he genuinely cares.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Good prof, be able to take really good notes because the exam questions are almost word-for-word from lecture. Lectures are in person but all quizzes and exams are online through canvas, and open note.

I agree 150% with other comments that Prof. Mitchell is an amazing, entertaining lecturer, and one of the best teachers at A&M.  It is so obvious that he really loves what he's doing, and cares about us learning it.  I did not find the class as easy as others have said, for me tests were tough but fair. Take him, go to lectures! He is the G.O.A.T.!

To get an A, just attend his lectures, take great notes (no online slides/notes). His lectures aren't boring whatsoever since he loves history. Quizzes and exams are fairly easy, and the 3-page paper isn't graded harshly. He offers extra credit too, which can boost your grade. He is also accessible outside of class and responds to emails quickly.

All you have to do is show up to class and take decent enough notes. Professor Mitchell made the class enjoyable and was eager to help any student that needed it. He is super friendly. He made the class challenging enough for the grade to be rewarding but easy enough to where it wasn't a big time commitment. I would love to be in his class again.

Professor Mitchell takes the time out of his day to help any student in need. This course is dependent on you and how you apply yourself. Everything you need to know is taught during the lecture, and no textbook is needed. The lectures are extremely interesting and he formats the information given in a story format.

Prof Mitchell is hands down the best history professor at A&M (in my biased opinion lol). He does NOT share his PowerPoints but his lectures are funny and interesting, which makes u want to take good notes. 4 Exams, 2 book quizzes, 1 (optional) extra credit essay and one book essay. Class is organized. Take him! You will learn a lot.
Dr. Mitchell is the best history professor I have ever had. Every lecture is super interesting and unbiased, and as long as you show up and take good notes in lecture the exams are a breeze.

BEST PROFESSOR EVER. I would recommend Mitchell to EVERYONE. His lectures were so incredible and interesting. If you do not go to class, DO NOT take him. He does not post the slideshows, and they don't have words. The tests are hard, but they are open note. Gives an amazing E.C opportunity. Overall, such an amazing passionate professor.

Amazing Prof! One of the best I've had! Go to lectures, take good notes, you can use them on the exams. We read two books but no one really read them, and I made an A. There is a third book you choose yourself and an extra credit movie assignment. Super easy, entertaining, and just a really good guy.

Great class because of Professor Mitchell.  Anyone who can make war, progressive era, civil rights, and watergate fun and entertaining is amazing!  Tests come from lectures, go to class and take good notes. Very nice outside of class too. Take this professor, you won't regret it.

Attendance isn't mandatory but he has open note tests that you can make easy A's on as long as you take detailed notes. The lectures were super entertaining and not boring like most other history courses. Zero homework other than two book quizzes and a paper over a third book. Definitely one of my favorite professors so far.

lectures are very interesting and the tests are fully based on lectures. attendance not mandatory but the tests are hard to pass if you do not show up to lectures. 3 tests + non cumulative final, all online and be taken anywhere. there are 2 book quizzes and an essay for another. extra credit offered if you write a paper on a historical movie
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Graded by few things--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: I took 106 for my core curriculum, and am in no way a history buff. Professor Mitchell is an amazing lecturer, and it made me WANT to go to every class. He made the material easy to understand and fun. There are 2 books, and 2 papers, one is for extra credit. His exams are open note and online, and if you attend class, you will get an A. Take him!

I am not a history buff, so this class was challenging for me. I attended every lecture and took good notes, but I struggled to keep my grade up. Professor Mitchell is pretty cool and I would not discourage anyone from taking his class.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very good professor. Explains everything that will be on the test in class. Make sure to take good notes though otherwise you will struggle on exams. Can't miss lectures otherwise you will lose out on the material given, and it will affect you on the test. If you take decent notes the class should be pretty easy. Gives extra credit. No homework

Amazing professor!  Great at what he does, and looks like he's loving doing it.  Cares about the students. Go to class and take good notes and you'll do fine.  Material can be bit difficult, but Professor Mitchell makes it all connect and make sense. Definitely take him over anyone else.  I signed up for his 106 just to listen to him lecture again!

Professor Mitchell made history very interesting. Attending the lectures isn't "required," but they are also not recorded and the slides are not posted. The test questions all come from the lectures. There were 3 required book readings in the course, 2 with a quiz and 1 with a book review paper. The final grade is only the quizzes, exams and paper.

Professor Mitchell is great, he is by far the best Professor and Lecturer I've had. His class is easy and straightforward if you come to the Lectures, take Notes, and start reading the Books early. He also gives a lot of Extra Credit; if you need anything, email him! He takes a lot of time to give students feedback and help them improve.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Great Professor that gives extra credit. Test are exactly like the lectures so you should go to class. Quizzes are just two books. Free A as long as you write everything down and pay attention in class. There is 0 studying needed outside of class allowing you to focus on other classes.

I highly recommend Professor Mitchell! This was his first class teaching & I had no idea as he was very knowledgable.
-Entertaining lectures
-Great communication-answers emails very quick
-Give's up to 10 points of extra credit
-Attendance not required-but tests come straight from lectures (Go to class!)
-Tests are open note & can be taken anywhere
Professor Mitchell is amazing!! His class is great! I would recommend going to his classes because his lectures are what is on the test. He is very approachable and fun! TAKE HIS CLASS!! BEST PROF!

An amazing professor that keeps the class engaging and enjoyable as well as being available and open to help. Great speaker and is very knowledgable on any topic discussed. He has an Extra Credit assignment that really helps to keep a good grade in his class. 10/10 would take his class again!

Professor Mitchell is just so awesome. If you need a history credit, take him! His lectures are engaging and exactly what you will see on exams. He is very caring and accessible outside of class. Such a nice guy would 100% take again. Go to class and you will succeed.

Professor Mitchell is an excellent professor! His lectures are entertaining, clear, and he is an excellent speaker. I highly recommend taking him for HIST 105. Tests are open note and very fair. Attendance is not required, but if you don't attend class you won't do well. All tests are straight out of the lectures so GO TO CLASS!

Professor Mitchell is an excellent lecturer, as long as you listen to whatever he is saying and take notes on it you will do fine on the exams. The exams are open note and everything he lectures about is on there, history is fascinating when taking it with Professor Mitchell.  It is very important to attend every lecture!

Only half way through the semester, and he is hands down the best professor I've ever had at A&M. Entertaining informative lectures, great power points. Tough but fair tests; if you go to class and take good notes, you'll do well.  Answer emails quickly, always makes himself available to help, seems to care about the students. Take this professor!
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class
